"""Pure supported-recovery structure checks; zero market/account/provider access."""
from copy import deepcopy
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
from types import ModuleType
import ast
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
import traceback
from unittest.mock import patch

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from strategy_runtime import ParameterSet, StrategyCandidate, StrategyRuntime, implementation_sha256
from strategy_evaluator import (AssessmentCandidate, ParameterCoordinate, ParameterCoordinateKind,
    ParameterDesignRequest, ParameterPerturbationProtocol, ParameterSpace, build_parameter_perturbation_design)

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
SOURCE = HERE / 'strategy_runtime'
PRIOR = ROOT / 'research/S013/experiments/EX055_20261011/src/strategy_runtime'
MODULE = 'bear_time_below_supported_recovery_range'
OLD_ENUM = 'RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_ACF_RECOVERY'
ENUM = 'RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_SUPPORTED_ACF_RECOVERY'
FILES = ['strategies/' + n + '.py' for n in ('range_reversion', 'adaptive_range', 'confirmed_range',
         'reentry_confirmed_range', MODULE, '__init__')]


def load(source, package, module):
    pkg = ModuleType(package)
    pkg.__path__ = [str(source / 'strategies')]
    sys.modules[package] = pkg
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(package + '.' + module, source / 'strategies' / (module + '.py'))
    item = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = item
    spec.loader.exec_module(item)
    return item


def main():
    checks, refusals = [], []
    def check(name, value=True):
        assert value, name
        checks.append(name)
    def refuse(name, call):
        try:
            call()
        except (ValueError, TypeError, AssertionError, KeyError):
            refusals.append(name)
        else:
            raise AssertionError('Expected refusal: ' + name)
    new = load(SOURCE, '_s013_supported_new', MODULE)
    old = load(PRIOR, '_s013_supported_old', 'bear_time_below_recovery_range')
    plan = json.loads((ROOT / 'research/S013/experiments/EX012_20261011/protocols/plan.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    center = deepcopy(next(r for r in plan['configurations'] if r['candidate_id'] == 'C2132')['payload']['parameters'])
    p = {**center, 'mechanism': ENUM}

    # Remove only the disclosed fixed support computation/context term/column,
    # and normalize the new type identity. All production loop/score/exit code
    # then equals the entire frozen55 module AST, not merely selected branches.
    prior_text = (PRIOR / 'strategies/bear_time_below_recovery_range.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    current_text = (SOURCE / 'strategies' / (MODULE + '.py')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    normalized = current_text.replace('BearTimeBelowSupportedRecoveryRange', 'BearTimeBelowRecoveryRange').replace(ENUM, OLD_ENUM)
    prior_ast, new_ast = ast.parse(prior_text), ast.parse(normalized)
    class Restore(ast.NodeTransformer):
        def visit_Expr(self, node):
            if isinstance(node.value, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value.value, str):
                return None
            return self.generic_visit(node)
        def visit_Assign(self, node):
            if any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'support' for t in node.targets):
                return None
            return self.generic_visit(node)
        def visit_BoolOp(self, node):
            node.values = [v for v in node.values if not (isinstance(v, ast.Subscript)
                and isinstance(v.value, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(v.value.value, ast.Name)
                and v.value.value.id == 'support' and v.value.attr == 'iloc')]
            return self.generic_visit(node)
        def visit_Call(self, node):
            node.keywords = [k for k in node.keywords if k.arg != 'entry_recovery_support_pass']
            return self.generic_visit(node)
    check('whole55_AST_exact_except_disclosed_support_and_type',
          ast.dump(Restore().visit(prior_ast), include_attributes=False) == ast.dump(Restore().visit(new_ast), include_attributes=False))
    for filename in ('range_reversion.py', 'adaptive_range.py', 'confirmed_range.py', 'reentry_confirmed_range.py'):
        check('frozen55_parent_byteexact_' + filename,
              (SOURCE / 'strategies' / filename).read_bytes() == (PRIOR / 'strategies' / filename).read_bytes())
    model = new.BearTimeBelowSupportedRecoveryRange(ParameterSet(p))
    prior = old.BearTimeBelowRecoveryRange(ParameterSet({**p, 'mechanism': OLD_ENUM}))
    check('warmup_center_original180', model._warmup == prior._warmup == 180)
    payload = {'parameters': p, 'runtime': {'contract_version': 1,
               'module': 'strategy_runtime.strategies.' + MODULE, 'qualname': 'BearTimeBelowSupportedRecoveryRange',
               'source_files': FILES, 'source_sha256': implementation_sha256(FILES, source_root=SOURCE)}}
    definition = StrategyRuntime().describe(StrategyCandidate('S013', 'C0000', payload, SOURCE))
    check('public_authenticated_describe_only_no_registration', definition.parameters.sha256 == ParameterSet(p).sha256)

    rng = np.random.default_rng(13)
    dates = pd.bdate_range('2018-01-01', periods=740)
    prices = 10 * np.exp(np.cumsum(rng.normal(.0001, .02, len(dates))))
    bars = pd.DataFrame({'Date': dates, 'Close': prices, 'Open': prices * .999,
        'High': prices * 1.01, 'Low': prices * .99, 'Volume': np.exp(rng.normal(14, .3, len(dates))),
        'Amount': np.exp(rng.normal(18, .3, len(dates)))})
    sessions = dates[400:]
    history = model.calculate_history({'daily': bars}, sessions)
    previous = prior.calculate_history({'daily': bars}, sessions)
    check('only_one_new_diagnostic_column', set(history) == set(previous) | {'entry_recovery_support_pass'})
    static = ['acf1', 'close', 'momentum20', 'regime', 'regime_momentum', 'bull_range_position',
              'bear_range_position', 'confirmation_score', 'confirmation_acf', 'confirmation_turnover',
              'confirmation_volume', 'confirmation_pass', 'entry_direction_up', 'previous_signal_close',
              'entry_signal_close', 'entry_signal_open', 'bear_acf_raw']
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(history[static], previous[static], check_exact=True)
    check('original_raw_features_score_threshold_pass_body_exact55')
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(history.entry_recovery_support_pass, history.confirmation_score.ge(0))
    check('support_bool_equals_original_score_ge_zero_all_rows')
    changed = bars.copy()
    changed.loc[560:, ['Open', 'Close', 'High', 'Low', 'Volume', 'Amount']] *= 1.7
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(model.calculate_history({'daily': changed}, sessions).iloc[:160], history.iloc[:160], check_exact=True)
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(model.calculate_history({'daily': bars.iloc[:560]}, dates[400:560]), history.iloc[:160], check_exact=True)
    check('complete_schema_future_mutation_and_prefix_causal')

    def controlled(*, score=0., acf=0., body=True, threshold=-.2, context_price=9.,
                   exit_route='bear', last_reason='time', range_ok=True, momentum_ok=True):
        params = deepcopy(p)
        params['regime_threshold'] = .2
        params['confirmation']['threshold'] = threshold
        params['bear']['max_hold'] = params['bull']['max_hold'] = 1
        params['bear']['momentum_min'] = 0. if not momentum_ok else None
        closes = [10., context_price, 8.9]
        data = bars.iloc[:403].copy()
        data.loc[380:399, 'Close'] = 10.
        data.loc[400:, 'Close'] = closes
        data.loc[400:, 'Open'] = [11., context_price + 1., 8.8 if body else 9.]
        if exit_route == 'bull':
            data.loc[400:401, 'Close'] = [13., 12.]
        data['High'] = data[['Open', 'Close']].max(axis=1) * 1.01
        data['Low'] = data[['Open', 'Close']].min(axis=1) * .99
        ranges = np.full(len(data), .5)
        ranges[-1] = .5 if range_ok else .95
        if last_reason == 'range':
            ranges[-2] = 1.
        acfs = np.full(len(data), .2)
        acfs[-1] = acf
        scores = np.full(len(data), .2)
        scores[-1] = score
        momenta = np.zeros(len(data))
        momenta[-1] = -.1 if not momentum_ok else 0.
        feature = pd.DataFrame({'range_position': ranges, 'acf1': acfs, 'close': data.Close.to_numpy(),
                               'momentum20': momenta}, index=pd.DatetimeIndex(data.Date))
        normalized = pd.DataFrame({'acf': scores, 'turnover': scores, 'volume': scores}, index=feature.index)
        with patch.object(new, 'components', lambda *_: feature.copy()), patch.object(new, 'confirmation_features', lambda *_: (normalized.copy(), normalized.copy())):
            return new.BearTimeBelowSupportedRecoveryRange(ParameterSet(params)).calculate_history({'daily': data}, dates[400:403])

    for score in (-.4, -.1, 0., .05, .1):
        result = controlled(score=score)
        check('local_support_zero_boundary_' + str(score), bool(result.entry_recovery_support_pass.iloc[2]) == (score >= 0))
        check('recovery_requires_nonnegative_only_in_exception_' + str(score), bool(result.entry_acf_recovery_applies.iloc[2]) == (score >= 0))
        check('support_does_not_redefine_confirmation_pass_' + str(score), bool(result.confirmation_pass.iloc[2]) == (score >= -.2))
        check('negative_supported_exception_stays_flat_not_direction_veto_' + str(score), result.signal_reason.iloc[2] == ('entry' if score >= 0 else 'flat'))
    for score in (-.1, 0., .05):
        result = controlled(score=score, acf=.2, body=False)
        check('originalpassing_negative_or_positive_bodydown_entry_preserved_' + str(score), result.signal_reason.iloc[2] == 'entry')
        check('originalpassing_not_marked_exception_' + str(score), not result.entry_acf_recovery_applies.iloc[2])
    result = controlled(score=.05, threshold=.1)
    check('higher_theta_exception_supported_and_context_retained', result.entry_acf_recovery_applies.iloc[2] and result.entry_recovery_support_pass.iloc[2])
    check('higher_theta_native_confirmation_remains_false', not result.confirmation_pass.iloc[2])
    check('higher_theta_supported_recovery_still_confirmation_rejected', result.signal_reason.iloc[2] == 'confirmation_rejected')
    for name, kwargs in [('BODYdown', {'body': False}), ('EQUALcontext', {'context_price': 10.}),
                         ('ABOVEcontext', {'context_price': 11.}), ('bull_exit', {'exit_route': 'bull'}),
                         ('range_exit', {'last_reason': 'range'}), ('range_failure', {'range_ok': False}),
                         ('momentum_failure', {'momentum_ok': False})]:
        result = controlled(**kwargs)
        check('unsupported_scope_never_recovers_' + name, not result.entry_acf_recovery_applies.iloc[2])
    check('holding_day_no_eligibility_exception', not controlled().entry_acf_recovery_applies.iloc[1])
    check('holding_TIME_preserved_despite_support_gate', controlled(score=-.1).signal_reason.iloc[1] == 'time')

    # Independent frozen55 formulas/state; mask only its recovery-direction
    # input with fixed score support, recompute state from initial flat, then
    # retain the BODY diagnostic unchanged. This never imports new model code.
    common = ModuleType('common')
    common.SOURCE_CALLS = []
    previous_common = sys.modules.get('common')
    sys.modules['common'] = common
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('_independent55_supported_reference', ROOT / 'research/S013/experiments/EX055_20261011/src/raw_recovery_oracle.py')
    oracle = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(oracle)
    if previous_common is None:
        del sys.modules['common']
    else:
        sys.modules['common'] = previous_common
    indexed = bars.copy()
    indexed.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(indexed.Date).normalize()
    geometry = json.loads((ROOT / 'research/S013/experiments/EX055_20261011/protocols/geometry.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    def get_path(params, name):
        target = params
        for key in name.split('.'):
            target = target[key]
        return target
    space = ParameterSpace(tuple(ParameterCoordinate(name, float(get_path(p, name)), low, high,
          ParameterCoordinateKind(kind)) for name, low, high, kind in geometry['coordinates']), 'a' * 64, 'b' * 64)
    design_result = build_parameter_perturbation_design(ParameterDesignRequest(AssessmentCandidate('S013-C0000', 'c' * 64),
              ParameterPerturbationProtocol(**geometry['protocol']), space), feasibility=lambda v: v[1] < v[2] and v[5] < v[6])
    assert design_result.status.value == 'COMPLETE'
    check('complete13_same32_seed13_radius005', len(geometry['coordinates']) == 13 and len(design_result.design.points) == 32
          and geometry['protocol'] == {'radius': .05, 'point_count': 32, 'seed': 13})
    for index, point in enumerate([None, *design_result.design.points]):
        cp = deepcopy(p)
        if point is not None:
            for (name, _, _, kind), value in zip(geometry['coordinates'], point.coordinates, strict=True):
                parts = name.split('.')
                target = cp
                for key in parts[:-1]:
                    target = target[key]
                target[parts[-1]] = int(value) if kind == 'INTEGER' else float(value)
        actual = new.BearTimeBelowSupportedRecoveryRange(ParameterSet(cp)).calculate_history({'daily': bars}, sessions)
        reference_p = {**cp, 'mechanism': OLD_ENUM}
        expected = oracle._reconstruct(indexed, sessions, reference_p)
        body = expected.entry_direction_up.copy()
        supported = expected.confirmation_score.ge(0)
        expected['entry_direction_up'] = body & supported
        expected = oracle._state_path(expected, reference_p)
        expected['entry_direction_up'] = body
        expected['entry_recovery_support_pass'] = supported
        internal = {'holding_before', 'route_before', 'age_before', 'active_route', 'eligible'}
        fields = [name for name in expected if name not in internal]
        assert set(fields) == set(actual.columns)
        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual[fields], expected[fields], check_exact=True, check_names=False, check_freq=False)
        check('independent_full_formula_state_all_fields_samecoordinate_' + str(index))
    corner = deepcopy(p)
    corner['bull']['range_window'] = corner['bear']['range_window'] = 21
    corner['regime_window'] = 60
    corner['confirmation']['lookback'] = 40
    native = new.BearTimeBelowSupportedRecoveryRange(ParameterSet(corner))
    prior_corner = old.BearTimeBelowRecoveryRange(ParameterSet({**corner, 'mechanism': OLD_ENUM}))
    check('minimum61_original_parent_warmup', native._warmup == prior_corner._warmup == 61)
    native.calculate_history({'daily': bars}, dates[61:66])
    check('minimum61_finite_causal_inputs')
    refuse('insufficient_parent_history', lambda: native.calculate_history({'daily': bars.iloc[:55]}, dates[20:55]))
    for name in ('Open', 'Close'):
        bad = bars.copy()
        bad.loc[500, name] = np.nan
        refuse('finite_required_' + name, lambda bad=bad: model.calculate_history({'daily': bad}, sessions))
    for name, value in [('mechanism', OLD_ENUM), ('regime_window', 60.5)]:
        bad = deepcopy(p)
        bad[name] = value
        refuse('invalid_parameter_' + name, lambda bad=bad: new.BearTimeBelowSupportedRecoveryRange(ParameterSet(bad)))
    result = {'status': 'PURE_PASS', 'checks': checks, 'check_count': len(checks), 'refusals': refusals,
              'refusal_count': len(refusals), 'source_files': {name: sha256((SOURCE / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in FILES},
              'source_sha256': sha256((SOURCE / 'strategies' / (MODULE + '.py')).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              'implementation_sha256': implementation_sha256(FILES, source_root=SOURCE),
              'focused_source_sha256': sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              'native_account_reads': 0, 'market_reads': 0, 'new_account_preparations': 0,
              'new_account_evaluations': 0, 'provider_calls': [], 'registrations': 0, 'publication_calls': 0,
              'limits': 'Pure synthetic support/state/formula equivalence only. score>=0 is a fixed rank-neutral categorical support condition outside13 numeric coordinates; originaltheta remains tunable and may further reject. No economic or 2023 recovery claim; unseen evaluation not performed.'}
    assert not (HERE / 'focused.json').exists()
    (HERE / 'focused.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({k: result[k] for k in ('status', 'check_count', 'refusal_count', 'source_sha256', 'implementation_sha256')}, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        main()
    except Exception as error:
        history = HERE / 'history/failed_attempt1'
        history.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        sources = {}
        for path in [Path(__file__), *(SOURCE / name for name in FILES)]:
            relative = path.relative_to(HERE)
            target = history / relative
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            data = path.read_bytes()
            target.write_bytes(data)
            sources[relative.as_posix()] = sha256(data).hexdigest()
        failure = {'status': 'FAILED', 'new_account_evaluations': 0, 'native_account_reads': 0,
                   'market_reads': 0, 'error': str(error), 'traceback': traceback.format_exc(), 'sources': sources}
        (history / 'failure.json').write_text(json.dumps(failure, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
        raise

"""S013 causal dual-route range strategy; routing uses only known daily closes."""
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import replace
import math

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from strategy_runtime import InputContract, ParameterSet

from .range_reversion import RangeReversion, components


class AdaptiveRange(RangeReversion):
    def __init__(self, parameters):
        p = parameters.values
        if set(p) != {'bull', 'bear', 'regime_window', 'regime_threshold',
                      'exit_on_regime_change'}:
            raise ValueError('exact adaptive parameter contract required')
        if type(p['regime_window']) is not int or not 5 <= p['regime_window'] <= 60:
            raise ValueError('regime_window must be 5..60 sessions')
        if (type(p['regime_threshold']) is not float
                or not math.isfinite(p['regime_threshold'])
                or not -.2 <= p['regime_threshold'] <= .2):
            raise ValueError('regime_threshold must be a finite float in [-.2,.2]')
        if type(p['exit_on_regime_change']) is not bool:
            raise ValueError('exit_on_regime_change must be bool')
        for key in ('bull', 'bear'):
            if not isinstance(p[key], Mapping):
                raise ValueError(key + ' must contain complete range parameters')
        self._routes = {
            key: RangeReversion(ParameterSet(p[key])) for key in ('bull', 'bear')
        }
        if p['bull']['limit_premium'] != p['bear']['limit_premium']:
            raise ValueError('route limit_premium must be identical')
        self._parameters = parameters
        self._warmup = max(p['bull']['range_window'], p['bear']['range_window'],
                           p['regime_window'] + 1, 21)

    @property
    def definition(self):
        base = self._routes['bull'].definition
        requirements = tuple(
            replace(item, lookback_sessions=self._warmup)
            if item.name == 'daily' else item for item in base.inputs.requirements
        )
        return replace(base, parameters=self._parameters,
                       inputs=InputContract(requirements))

    def calendar_request(self, window):
        return super().calendar_request(window)

    def calculate_history(self, inputs, sessions):
        p = self._parameters.values
        route_features = {
            key: components(inputs['daily'], p[key]['range_window']).reindex(sessions)
            for key in ('bull', 'bear')
        }
        for feature in route_features.values():
            if not np.isfinite(feature.to_numpy()).all():
                raise ValueError('required causal route features missing')
        bars = inputs['daily'].copy()
        bars.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(bars.Date)).normalize()
        close = bars.Close.astype(float)
        regime_momentum = (close / close.shift(p['regime_window']) - 1).reindex(sessions)
        if not np.isfinite(regime_momentum.to_numpy()).all():
            raise ValueError('required causal regime features missing')
        regimes = np.where(regime_momentum.to_numpy() >= p['regime_threshold'],
                           'bull', 'bear')
        holding = False
        active_route = None

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from strategy_runtime import ParameterSet
from .reentry_confirmed_range import ReentryConfirmedRange
from .confirmed_range import PROFILES, confirmation_features
from .range_reversion import components


class BearTimeBelowSupportedRecoveryRange(ReentryConfirmedRange):
    def __init__(self, parameters):
        p = parameters.values
        if p.get("mechanism") != "RAW_BEAR_TIME_BELOW_BODY_SUPPORTED_ACF_RECOVERY":
            raise ValueError("explicit raw bear TIME BELOW body ACF recovery mechanism required")
        if p.get("confirmation", {}).get("enabled") is not True:
            raise ValueError("original buy confirmation must remain enabled")
        super().__init__(
            ParameterSet({key: value for key, value in p.items() if key != "mechanism"})
        )
        self._parameters = parameters

    def calculate_history(self, inputs, sessions):
        p = self._parameters.values
        c, settings = p["confirmation"], p["context"]
        daily = inputs["daily"]
        if not {"Date", "Open", "Close"}.issubset(daily.columns):
            raise ValueError("complete signal Date/Open/Close required")
        prices = daily.loc[:, ["Open", "Close"]].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        if not np.isfinite(prices).all() or (prices <= 0).any():
            raise ValueError("signal Open/Close must be finite and positive")
        all_features = {
            key: components(inputs["daily"], p[key]["range_window"]) for key in ("bull", "bear")
        }
        raw_bear_acf = all_features["bear"].acf1
        features = {key: frame.reindex(sessions) for key, frame in all_features.items()}
        if not all(np.isfinite(frame.to_numpy()).all() for frame in features.values()):
            raise ValueError("required causal route features missing")
        score_bars = inputs["daily"].copy()
        if settings["volume_basis"] == "RAW":
            raw = inputs["execution"].copy()
            raw.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(raw.Date)).normalize()
            score_bars.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(score_bars.Date)).normalize()
            if (
                not raw.index.is_unique
                or not raw.index.is_monotonic_increasing
                or not raw.index.isin(score_bars.index).all()
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    "raw volume dates must be unique, ordered and share the adjusted calendar"
                )
            adjusted = score_bars.loc[raw.index]
            reconstructed = adjusted.Volume * adjusted.Close / raw.Close
            if not np.allclose(
                reconstructed.to_numpy(), raw.Volume.to_numpy(), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-6
            ):
                raise ValueError("per-date raw/HFQ volume conversion differs")
            if not np.allclose(
                adjusted.Amount.to_numpy(), raw.Amount.to_numpy(), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-6
            ):
                raise ValueError("amount must be invariant across price-unit conversion")
            score_bars = adjusted.assign(Volume=raw.Volume)
        _, normalized = confirmation_features(score_bars, all_features["bull"].acf1, c["lookback"])
        normalized = normalized.reindex(sessions)
        if not np.isfinite(normalized.to_numpy()).all():
            raise ValueError("complete causal confirmation history missing")
        score = (
            0.5 * normalized.acf + 0.25 * normalized.turnover + 0.25 * normalized.volume
            if settings["weighting"] == "EQUAL_BLOCKS"
            else normalized.loc[:, list(PROFILES[c["profile"]])].mean(axis=1)
        ) * c["orientation"]
        support = score.ge(0)
        bars = inputs["daily"].copy()
        bars.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(bars.Date)).normalize()
        close = bars.Close.astype(float)
        signal_close = close.reindex(sessions)
        signal_open = bars.Open.astype(float).reindex(sessions)
        previous_close = close.shift(1).reindex(sessions)
        if not np.isfinite(np.column_stack((signal_close, signal_open, previous_close))).all():
            raise ValueError("complete current and previous signal prices required")
        direction = (signal_close > signal_open).to_numpy()
        all_momentum = close / close.shift(p["regime_window"]) - 1
        momentum = all_momentum.reindex(sessions)
        if not np.isfinite(momentum.to_numpy()).all():
            raise ValueError("required causal regime features missing")
        regimes = np.where(momentum.to_numpy() >= p["regime_threshold"], "bull", "bear")
        holding = False
        active_route = None
        last_exit_reason = None
        last_exit_route = None
        last_exit_category = None
        age = 0
        anchor = peak = 0.0
        targets, reasons, positions, opportunities, passes, contexts = [], [], [], [], [], []
        entry_acf_values, entry_acf_passes, direction_gate_applies = [], [], []
        recovery_flags, eligibility_flags = [], []
        previous_exit_reasons, previous_exit_routes, previous_exit_categories = [], [], []
        for i, regime in enumerate(regimes):
            previous_exit_reasons.append(last_exit_reason)
            previous_exit_routes.append(last_exit_route)
            previous_exit_categories.append(last_exit_category)
            route = active_route if holding else regime
            rp = p[route]
            row = features[route].iloc[i]
            positions.append(row.range_position)
            entry_acf = row.acf1
            acf_pass = rp["acf_min"] is None or entry_acf >= rp["acf_min"]
            entry_acf_values.append(entry_acf)
            entry_acf_passes.append(acf_pass)
            range_pass = row.range_position <= rp["entry"]
            momentum_pass = rp["momentum_min"] is None or row.momentum20 >= rp["momentum_min"]
            recovery_context = (
                not holding
                and regime == "bear"
                and last_exit_reason == "time"
                and last_exit_route == "bear"
                and last_exit_category == "BELOW"
                and direction[i]
                and support.iloc[i]
            )
            recovered = range_pass and momentum_pass and not acf_pass and recovery_context
            eligible = range_pass and momentum_pass and (acf_pass or recovery_context)
            recovery_flags.append(bool(recovered))
            eligibility_flags.append(bool(eligible))
            applies = c["scope"] in ("both", regime) and (
                settings["entry_gate"] == "all" or last_exit_reason == "regime"
            )
            opportunity = not holding and eligible
            # BODY is an eligibility exception, never an extra veto of original entries.
            direction_gate_applies.append(False)
            passed = not applies or score.iloc[i] >= c["threshold"]
            opportunities.append(opportunity)
            passes.append(passed)
            contexts.append(last_exit_reason or "initial")
            reason = "flat"
            if holding:
                age += 1
                peak = max(peak, row.close)
                loss = rp["stop_loss"] is not None and row.close / anchor - 1 <= -rp["stop_loss"]
                trail = (
                    rp["trailing_stop"] is not None and row.close / peak - 1 <= -rp["trailing_stop"]
                )
                changed = p["exit_on_regime_change"] and regime != active_route
                if (
                    loss
                    or trail
                    or row.range_position >= rp["exit"]
                    or age >= rp["max_hold"]
                    or changed
                ):
                    holding = False
                    reason = (
                        "loss"
                        if loss
                        else "trailing"
                        if trail
                        else "range"
                        if row.range_position >= rp["exit"]
                        else "time"
                        if age >= rp["max_hold"]
                        else "regime"
                    )
                    last_exit_reason = reason
                    last_exit_route = active_route
                    # Classify only the final bear TIME exit against this signal episode's anchor.
                    last_exit_category = (
                        (
                            "BELOW"
                            if row.close < anchor
                            else "ABOVE"
                            if row.close > anchor
                            else "EQUAL"
                        )
                        if reason == "time" and active_route == "bear"
                        else None
                    )
                    active_route = None
                else:
                    reason = "hold"
            elif eligible:
                if passed:
                    holding = True
                    active_route = regime
                    age = 0
                    anchor = peak = row.close
                    last_exit_reason = None
                    last_exit_route = None
                    last_exit_category = None
                    reason = "entry"
                else:
                    reason = "confirmation_rejected"
            targets.append(float(holding))
            reasons.append(reason)
        history = features["bull"].assign(
            range_position=positions,
            target_position=targets,
            signal_reason=reasons,
            regime=regimes,
            regime_momentum=momentum,
            entry_direction_gate_applies=direction_gate_applies,
            entry_direction_up=direction,
            previous_signal_close=previous_close,
            entry_signal_close=signal_close,
            entry_signal_open=signal_open,
            bull_range_position=features["bull"].range_position,
            bear_range_position=features["bear"].range_position,
            confirmation_score=score,
            confirmation_acf=normalized.acf,
            confirmation_turnover=normalized.turnover,
            confirmation_volume=normalized.volume,
            confirmation_opportunity=opportunities,
            confirmation_pass=passes,
            confirmation_exit_context=contexts,
            last_exit_reason=pd.Series(previous_exit_reasons, index=sessions, dtype=object),
            last_exit_route=pd.Series(previous_exit_routes, index=sessions, dtype=object),
            last_exit_category=pd.Series(previous_exit_categories, index=sessions, dtype=object),
            bear_acf_raw=raw_bear_acf.reindex(sessions),
            entry_acf_value=entry_acf_values,
            entry_acf_pass=entry_acf_passes,
            entry_acf_recovery_applies=recovery_flags,
            entry_eligible=eligibility_flags,
            entry_recovery_support_pass=support.to_numpy(),
        )
        return history

    'turnover_volume': ('turnover', 'volume'), 'all': ('acf', 'turnover', 'volume'),
}


def causal_rank(values, window):
    """S007-v1 midrank formula; complete trailing window, centered on zero."""
    def last(items):
        current = items[-1]
        return float((np.count_nonzero(items < current)
                      + .5 * np.count_nonzero(items == current)) / len(items) - .5)
    return values.rolling(window, min_periods=window).apply(last, raw=True)


def confirmation_features(bars, acf, window):
    frame = bars.copy()
    frame.index = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(frame.Date)).normalize()
    volume, amount = frame.Volume.astype(float), frame.Amount.astype(float)
    if not np.isfinite(volume).all() or not np.isfinite(amount).all() or (volume <= 0).any() or (amount <= 0).any():
        raise ValueError('confirmation requires finite positive volume and amount')
    raw = pd.DataFrame({'acf': acf, 'turnover': amount / amount.rolling(20).mean(),
                        'volume': np.log(volume).diff().rolling(20).mean()}, index=frame.index)
    return raw, raw.apply(lambda values: causal_rank(values, window))
